Elekid

Electric

Johto · Generation 2 · Baby Pokémon

Elekid is an Electric-type Electric Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 23.5 kg. It evolves into Electabuzz. Its highest base stat is Speed (95), with a base stat total of 360.
